pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with predominantly sub-rectilinear edges and rounded vertices. Edge transitions exhibit soft pixel gradients rather than sharp demarcations. Individual patches show moderate spatial area with relatively consistent size across the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a complete topological graph. Intersections are primarily tri-radial (Y-junctions) with some 4-way nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform, occupying approximately 10-15% of the total visible pelage area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a fine-grained, low-amplitude silhouette against the out-of-focus background. The frequency of the jagged hair clusters is high and consistent along the visible upper neck and shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent horizontal skin fold or crease is visible at the junction of the lower neck and shoulder, causing a distinct linear compression of the local pelage pattern.
